//: Shared jscpd (copy-paste detection) template for magicsunday/* projects. Copy to .jscpd.json and adjust `path` and `format`. Zero-tolerance: any clone over the token/line threshold fails the build. `format` must use jscpd's FORMAT names, not file extensions — "typescript"/"javascript"/"jsx"/"tsx", never "ts"/"js": an unknown name is not an error, it silently analyses nothing, so the gate would look active while detecting no clones at all. Drop the entries a repository has no sources for.
